name: Ariard -Shounen Alice-
source:
"Alice, I came to get you..."

One day after meeting a man calling himself White Rabbit , Miyano Alisumi sets foot into a mysterious world.  The sky is always colored red,  a kingdom of ruin.

"You are Alice, the one who is to become the next queen. Select the new king and save this world."

The residents of this underground country desire, love, and infringe upon Alice.

Are their desires those of lust, love, or for the world?
The story of the boy Alice begins...
translation:
“爱丽丝，我是来接你的……”

遇见自称白兔的男子一天后，宫野阿里澄踏入了一个神秘的世界。天空永远是红色的，是一个毁灭的王国。

“你是爱丽丝，即将成为下一任女王的人。选择新的国王并拯救这个世界。”

这个地下国度的居民对爱丽丝渴望、喜爱、侵犯。

他们的欲望是欲望、爱情还是世界？
男孩爱丽丝的故事开始了……
